trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing separate to do for it. Use the tracker to work through story first, then completion and cleanup, and this should be the last one to pop.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission called Gone Fishing and finish it. The description names it as the opener, so simply starting the story and completing that first job should earn this. No extra condition is stated, so do not worry about score or time here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that belongs to Chapter 1 and the trophy should unlock at the chapter break. Keep following the main story markers and avoid leaving a chapter mission half done. Nothing in the description suggests a choice or a one-time action is involved.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Work through the main missions of Chapter 2 until the chapter is complete. This is a straight story progression trophy, so steady progress through the chapter is the whole method. The description alone does not confirm any optional step tied to it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by finishing its main story missions in order. Keep a save near the end of each chapter in case you want to revisit a moment later. No special performance target is mentioned in the description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the main missions of Chapter 4 to unlock this chapter trophy. By this point the story is deep in, so keep your gear and money topped up between missions. The description gives no extra condition beyond completing the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Reach and complete the final mission of the main story. This is the gold story capstone, so expect it only after the earlier chapters are done. Keep a separate save before starting the finale in case any choice-related trophy needs a second look afterwards.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission named Breakfast Run whenever it appears in the story. Play it through to its completion screen and the trophy should register. The description does not state a medal, time, or stealth condition, so a clean finish is what matters.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called The Cartel Heist. Heist-style missions usually reward preparation, so go in stocked and follow the mission objectives to the end. Whether there are setup choices is not confirmed by the description alone, so this guide does not assume any.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission named Child's Play when it becomes available. Play the objectives in order and see the mission through to completion. No optional target is described, so there is nothing extra to chase during it based on the list alone.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission named Headliners. Follow its objectives from start to finish and let the mission conclude fully before moving on. The trophy list gives no medal or collectible condition for this one.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission called VCIA Takedown. The letters VCIA also appear in another trophy about a departure, but this one only asks for mission completion. Play it to the end and the trophy should unlock at completion.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission named Operation Savage Glory. Treat it as a standard story mission: follow the objectives, survive the set pieces, and finish. Nothing in the description confirms a special weapon, vehicle, or route requirement.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach a full 100 percent completion rating for the game. That will mean finishing the story and then clearing whatever the in-game completion checklist counts, such as activities, collectibles, and side strands. Check your in-game percentage regularly and save this grind for after the story, when the whole map is open.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete a total of 250 stunts. This is a volume trophy, so it rewards steady play over a long save rather than one perfect run. Mix stunt attempts into normal travel instead of leaving all 250 for the end, and keep count in the tracker as you go.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity at least once, with nine activity types indicated by the official hint. You only need a first attempt at each type, not mastery, so sample everything as it unlocks. If one type is left, compare what you have tried against the activities you have seen offered in the world.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, with 42 challenges indicated by the official hint. Practice one weapon or challenge type at a time and replay until the gold threshold is met. This is a skill trophy, so expect to repeat the harder ranges rather than clearing them first try.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location, with 14 locations indicated by the official hint. A win is required, not just a finish, so replay a location until you place first there. Tick locations off in your notes so the last missing course is easy to spot.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, meaning 20 separate race events rather than the same race 20 times. Spread your wins across the race types and locations the game offers. Keep a simple list of races already won so you do not waste time repeating one by mistake.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. The description names the opponent but not the winning score or catch, so the exact target is not confirmed by the list alone. Enter the challenge when it is offered and focus on outperforming Cal rather than on a fixed number.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Only a single completion is asked for, so pick whichever arcade game you find first and see it through. If a game offers a quit or credit screen, make sure you reach its actual end rather than backing out early.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission strand for Andy by completing his final mission. That means working through his earlier jobs first whenever they appear, so the finale can unlock. If his strand seems stalled, check for an unfinished earlier step for the same character.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Do his earlier missions as they show up so the last one becomes available, then finish it fully. The title is a joke, but the requirement is plain: Kenton's last job, completed.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission to close out his strand. Work through his preceding missions in order and do not leave the strand half done while chasing other characters. Completion of that last mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers spread across Leonida. A strand means the whole chain for one stranger, not just a first meeting, so follow each chain to its end. The character finales elsewhere in this list are a good model for how these chains close out.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission after finishing the earlier steps of his strand. Keep an eye out for his jobs as you travel, since side strands are easy to leave unfinished. Once his last mission is done, this trophy should follow.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Tyrone to complete his strand. Do his earlier missions first, then play the finale through to its end. No extra performance condition is stated in the description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, with 18 spots indicated by the official hint. Visit each spot and use the meditation prompt there rather than just discovering the place. Keep a regional checklist so you can tell which spots remain near the end.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal that Bret asks for. The description confirms the task giver and that the animal is unique, but it does not name the species or where it lives, so this guide does not invent either. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is given, then complete it as directed in game.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards. That means finding every card in each of three sets, not just collecting any three cards. Focus on finishing one set at a time so progress is visible, and use the tracker notes to record sets already completed.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations. The capitalisation in the name is the game's own joke, and the requirement is a count of places, so variety matters more than repetition in one spot. Work region by region and note areas already covered to avoid a long backtrack at 90 plus.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Pick off short challenges whenever they are offered instead of saving them all for cleanup. If the game tracks challenge progress somewhere in its menus, check it now and then so you know how far from 50 you really are.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While you are with your partner, build up a four star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Both parts matter: the heat must reach four stars with your partner present, and you must get clear afterwards. Plan an escape route before you start the trouble so the losing-the-heat part is not left to luck.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level in between. The chain breaks if the heat drops, so move directly from one shop to the next and keep the pressure on. Pick three shops reasonably close together when you attempt it, if the map allows.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery trophies like this usually register when you encounter or drive a new model, so swap cars often instead of living in one favourite. Visiting varied districts and events should expose you to rarer models over a full playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: During one single use of Combat Focus, take down five enemies. Wait for a crowded fight before triggering it, and line up your targets in advance so the window is not wasted. If an attempt falls short, it costs nothing to try again in the next big encounter.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, make a departure that is described as unscheduled. The list does not spell out the exact method, vehicle, or moment, so this guide will not invent one. When you are at VCIA in free play or a mission, look for a way to leave by air outside the normal routine and take it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one involves Rhinos, which in this series means tanks, and the joke description says it gets hot in them. The exact action required is not confirmed by the description alone, so do not trust any guide that states a precise method as fact. When you first get access to a Rhino, experiment with using it in combat and check whether the trophy registers.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get through it without being detected. Stealth is the whole point, so move carefully, watch sightlines, and avoid anything that raises an alarm mid-robbery. If you are spotted, leave, reset, and try the same store again more quietly.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each robbery. A vault only counts if you get away, so plan the exit before you start the job inside. Spread the five across your playthrough or chain them in cleanup, whichever suits your wanted level management.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and then escape. Only one truck is required, so take the first clean chance you get rather than hunting for a perfect setup. Make sure the escape is complete and the heat is gone before you consider it done.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida, with 52 areas indicated by the official hint. Travel into every region instead of fast travelling past the edges of the map. Late in a playthrough, compare the map area by area and sweep any district you have never actually entered.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, with nine gangs indicated by the official hint. One robbery per gang is the requirement, so keep a gang checklist and mark each one off as you hit it. Repeating a robbery against the same gang does not move this forward.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: On Ocean Beach, enjoy a cocktail somewhere with a view. The description names the place and the activity plainly, so head to Ocean Beach and look for the cocktail interaction there. If it is tied to a particular spot or moment, the description alone does not confirm which, so try the obvious beachside options first.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, driving through in classic style rather than walking out. Get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive out through the front instead of using a door on foot. The description does not name a specific showroom, so any showroom exit done this way is the sensible attempt.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the bowling alley named for Kolt and Associates and complete the follow-through action there. In bowling terms a follow-through is part of delivering the ball properly, so play a real game or turn at that alley rather than just entering the building. The exact scoring target, if any, is not stated in the description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description only says this is a partnership moment with mass appeal, which is too vague to state a precise method honestly. It likely involves your partner and some public-facing activity, but that is an inference, not a confirmed step. Watch for partner activities with an audience or a personal best score attached, and try those first.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy tracks choices you make, with a count up to 500 indicated by the official hint. Because story choices are often one-time decisions, this is marked missable in this guide: keep rotating saves before big decisions so a path can be revisited. Play the full story and make choices whenever the game offers them instead of skipping past them.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description says the second time is the charm, which points to failing or missing something once and then succeeding on a retry. It does not say which activity this belongs to, so no specific event is claimed here. If you fail a notable one-chance style attempt, retry it promptly and see if this registers.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange, in the description's own surprised words. This reads like a hidden or unusual event trophy, and the list gives no place, time, or trigger, so none is invented here. Explore off the beaten path, especially while completing the full map for other trophies, and investigate anything that looks deliberately out of place.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by, meaning a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle as you pass. Line up a target, keep your speed up, and strike as you go by rather than stopping to fight. It may take a few passes to land cleanly, so retry in a quiet area.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a total of 250,000 dollars by laundering marked bills through your contacts. This is a cumulative money total, so route marked bills to contacts whenever you have them instead of spending them another way. It pairs naturally with the robbery trophies, which should keep marked bills coming in.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative 100,000 dollars across all shops combined. Normal play should cover much of this if you buy clothes, gear, and services as you go rather than hoarding cash. If you finish the story short of the total, a deliberate shopping round in cleanup will close the gap.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property, with eight garages indicated by the official hint. Save money toward the full set instead of assuming one or two garages are enough. Once properties become available, buy them as your funds allow and tick each purchase off here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get a new vehicle you want to keep, register it in the app instead of leaving it unregistered. Ten registrations is a modest total, so this should finish early if you make registration a habit from the start.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
